Experimental_Design.Conditions: matching, nonmatching (shape association: self vs friend)

Block_Structure.Trial_number: 120 experimental trials (60 matching, 60 nonmatching; randomised order)

Trial_Structure.Response_deadline: 1200 ms (100 ms stimulus + 1100 ms blank or until response)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: Black square and triangle (150 x 150 pixels, presented at 5% of screen size)
Stimulus_Properties.Label: English words: self, friend

exp1.detail:
Participants recruited via Prolific (online testing; online participants may be located anywhere, so Location/City is not applicable per SKILL.md rule), compensated at 7.50 GBP/h. Response keys: V (matching) and B (nonmatching), counterbalanced. Shape-association task was the first of two tasks (second was a modified Attention Network Test, not included in the database). 70 participants recruited, 5 excluded for failing to follow instructions -> 65 in database (consistent with CSV Sample_Size 65 / Valid_Subj 65). Trial counts per participant range 89-120 in the clean data. Method source: paper full text (PMC10119901).
Data note (2026-08 P9): provided data has 7370 trials / 65 subjects = 45-120 trials per subject (expected 120; only 18 subjects have the full 120 trials, one has 45; kept as-is per minimal-preprocessing rule). CSV Sample_Size=65 / Valid_Subj=65 / Drop_Subj=0 (2026-09-02 corrected; the 5 paper exclusions never entered the database and are recorded in CSV Note Paper_N: 70 recruited, 5 excluded for failing to follow instructions; 65 in data).
